messages.text: Production operations needs one defensible decision for repeated bearing alarm on ASSET-025 by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside the third qualifying alarm plus reliability approval triggers planned work.
I found 7 ALARMS on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0025 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000025 up to 5 ALARMS, provided the third qualifying alarm plus reliability approval triggers planned work. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or continue_monitoring.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for next production-safe maintenance window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R9 and the CASE-026 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-025.

Required closeout records: record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell; and prepare the reply in the existing email thread and leave it as a draft for review; do not send it. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
